title: Gloves of Missile Snaring

sources.title: Missile Snaring
markers: | description = You can intercept missiles from ranged weapon attacks with a {{r|reaction}}, reducing their damage by {{DieIcon|d10|Physical}}'''1d10''' + your [[Ability Score Modifier|Dexterity modifier]].

summary: Spend a Reaction to reduce damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier. The attack’s other effects still apply.

fields.Base value: 160 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Missile Snaring: Reaction. Reduce ranged weapon damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier, applied separately to each incoming damage type. Other attack effects still apply. For a multi-projectile attack the pinned source reports only the last attack can be intercepted. Beast-shape transformations prevent its use.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
